_comment: Mockup v1 — BWV 227.1 'Jesu, meine Freude', first phrase (9 measures, E minor). LLM session work: hand-authored interpretive layer over the score. divisions=2 per quarter; PPQ for MIDI export = 480, so 1 division = 240 ticks.

seed.philosophy: Sing the chorale. Breathe at phrase ends. The soprano leads; inner voices support. E minor — dark, inward. Shape toward the half cadence at m.5 and the authentic arrival at m.9.
assertions: all score notes present, order preserved

tempo_map.note: m.4 — ease slightly into the descent to E
m.5 — half cadence (B): arrive, hold the breath
m.6 — resume; the answering phrase begins
m.8 — begin the ritardando toward the close

dynamics.note: mp — a consort, not a choir of hundreds
the climb to G5 — fullest sound
final chord — let it die away

humanize.note: tiny ensemble spread — voices do not attack as one machine; sop/alto slightly after beat 1 of each measure

phrase_final_notes.note: cadence notes lengthened — the choir holds the vowel
